correctionOf.reason: Earlier PASS treated the Main single-call execution arrangement as correcting the frozen contract. It only avoids the defect; this supplemental verdict governs Source01 contract conformance. Earlier report retained unchanged.

findings.finding: orderedAPIs requires standalone prepare then run_once. prepare exclusively creates job-bundle (root08_cli.py:24), and run_once calls prepare again (line45); following the frozen contract fails with FileExistsError before submission. Main direct-run_once arrangement avoids this but does not correct the frozen source contract.
findings.requiredChange: Source02 documentation/API/generator must describe run_once as the sole post-CAS public call with internal prepare; preserve runtime bytes, exclusive mkdir and no-replay.
findings.title: Ordered contract calls prepare twice through run_once
